Peerdas-devnet-7 sync test results (all supernodes, checkpoint sync was used): - Teku-nethermind: Synced - Nimbus-nethermind: Synced - Teku-reth: Synced - Prysm-reth: Synced - Lighthouse-reth: Synced (downloading historic blocks) - Nimbus-geth: Synced - Prysm-geth: Synced - Grandine-nethermind: Syncing - Prysm-nethermind: Syncing (and for some reason the "current difference" number keeps oscillating) - Lodestar-nethermind: Syncing - Nimbus-reth: Syncing (backfill underway) - Grandine-reth: Syncing - Lodestar-reth: Syncing - Grandine-geth: Syncing - Lodestar-geth: Syncing - Lighthouse-nethermind: Not syncing, had peers and synced till a certain height then it couldn't find peers - Teku-geth: ERROR (error pre-samping block ... not on canonical chain) - Lighthouse-geth: Synced (BUT ERROR Backfill sync failed to start) So there's clearly sync related work to be done 😄 I'll update the stats again tomorrow and maybe build something to make this more visible easily. And I've made a new PR which simplifies the blob schedule & getter function: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4341 which lh-geth has the backfill issue? I just spun one up locally to test, so you cant access it unfortunately try syncing it yourself maybe?
